newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl Oriental to sell property.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Oriental to sell property.

text.p: Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said on Sunday a company has agreed to buy 113,649 sq ft of office and retail space and 37 car parking spaces in its 65-percent-held Pearl Oriental Centre for HK$1.72 billion.

Sales turnover attributable to the listed group in the deal will be HK$1.1 billion, generating a pre-tax gross profit of about HK$652 million for Pearl Oriental, it said in a statement. Xin Hua Estate Ltd, an investment enterprise, will buy the 15 office floors, two shops and 37 car parking spaces in the building, the statement said.
